journey.name: Cross-Tab State Consistency
journey.description: Ensures that the watchlist status of a movie is consistent across Home, Search, and Watchlist screens.

actions.action: Wait for the app to load and ensure the "Ghibli Garden" home screen is visible.
Locate the "Explore Films" grid. Tap on the very first movie card you see in that grid.
Once on the details screen, note the EXACT movie title (e.g., "Castle in the Sky"). We will call this the 'Selected Movie'.
Tap the "Add to Watchlist" button. Wait a moment and confirm the button now says "In Watchlist".
Tap the "Search" tab in the bottom navigation bar to switch screens directly.
Type the EXACT 'Selected Movie' title into the search bar. Wait for the results.
Look for the movie result that EXACTLY matches the 'Selected Movie' title and tap it.
On this detail screen, verify that the button already shows "In Watchlist". This confirms the state was synced.
Tap the "In Watchlist" button to remove it. Verify it changes back to "Add to Watchlist".
Tap the "Watchlist" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify that the 'Selected Movie' title is no longer present in the watchlist list.
